name: Oakenscowl
summary: Along Lake Al'Ameth, blight spreads from a corrupted timberling called Oakenscowl. Denalan asks you to end the threat. The maddened creature dwells in a cave on the lake's southern bank.

sections.title: A Fallen Guardian
sections.body: Timberlings tend the boughs of Teldrassil, and Oakenscowl once led them. Now corruption runs through the world tree, reaching humble wildlife and ancient protectors alike. A massive growth swells across Oakenscowl's bark, driving the timberling mad. Where it once guarded the forest, blight now takes hold.

sections.title: Purging Lake Al'Ameth
sections.body: Oakenscowl hides in a cavern on Lake Al'Ameth's southern shore. Its presence poisons the nearby water and woodland beasts. Denalan cannot face the creature alone, so he seeks its destruction to cut off the corruption and study the strange growth afflicting the lake's spirits.

aliases: what kind of creature is oakenscowl
faq.answer: Oakenscowl is a massive timberling, a forest spirit tied to Teldrassil's plant life. The timberling once led its kind before a malignant growth took hold.
Oakenscowl's massive growth has twisted its mind and made it violently aggressive. From its cavern by Lake Al'Ameth, it spreads blight to nearby timberlings and beasts.
Oakenscowl dwells in a cavern on the southern shore of Lake Al'Ameth in southern Teldrassil.

faq.q: Who is Denalan and why is he studying the tumor?
faq.answer: Denalan is an herbalist and naturalist who lives on Lake Al'Ameth's eastern shore. He studies the world tree's plants and animals, seeking to understand and cure the strange rot infecting local timberlings.

faq.q: What caused the tumor on Oakenscowl?
faq.answer: The tumor points to a deeper sickness spreading through Teldrassil's soil and roots, corrupting nature spirits from within.
Oakenscowl's affliction has gone too far by the time adventurers find it. The growth has completely warped the timberling, leaving Denalan to call for a mercy kill.

angles.text: As a druid, seeing a guardian timberling warped by strange growths shows how deeply unwell Teldrassil's young ecosystem has become.
As a night elf, Oakenscowl's fall threatens Lake Al'Ameth, just south of Dolanaar, close to the heart of your people.
As an herbalist, you can see how unseen rot twists plant life into malignant, mossy blights while helping Denalan.
